landmarks.name: Elizabeth Dafoe Library
facts: It is the main library, named after a long-serving head librarian.
It opened in 1953; the university archives' annex was added to it in 2008.

landmarks.name: Investors Group Athletic Centre
facts: It was built for the 1999 Pan American Games.

landmarks.name: Wallace Building
facts: It displays a mineral collection arranged from the simplest to the most complex.

landmarks.name: Robson Hall
facts: It is home to the law school and its Legal Research Institute.
It is named after one of the law school's two founders.

landmarks.name: University Centre
facts: It is the student centre, with the bookstore and food court.

landmarks.name: Taché Hall
facts: It is a historic residence that also houses music and theatre spaces.

landmarks.name: Helen Glass Centre for Nursing
facts: It was named in 1999 after a Canadian leader in health-care education.

landmarks.name: ARTlab
facts: The School of Art and its gallery moved into it in 2012.

landmarks.name: Administration Building
facts: A Carnegie Corporation grant created a junior library here in 1935.
